sentences.text: No—the documents do not state a 2% cap for penal charges, and the current RBI direction says no upper limit / cap for penal charges has been prescribed.
The documents state only that such penal charges shall be reasonable and levied only on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner as per the Board approved policy.
The bank’s own documents state ₹500 per month of default in the home loan agreement and KFS, and 1% per annum on the amount in default for MSE business loans.

missing.slot: maximum penal charge based on a 2% cap
missing.searched: RBI directions and bank documents for any 2% cap or maximum penal charge
